title: Lotusland

services.name: Private Rentals
services.desc: Lotusland is a public garden operating in a residential neighborhood and operates under strict limitations set by the County of Santa Barbara. Unique limitations require unique rules so please plan in advance. All guests must make advanced reservations to visit. Lotusland offers a wide variety of Private Events and welcomes Members at the Garden Conservator level or above to contact our team of professionals for more information. A personal picnic in the garden is available to Members at the Garden Conservator level or above one time during their membership year.
